meta.title: A vendor bids itself after the buyer bid on its behalf: one live bid, at the vendor's price
gaps: The available read-backs cannot verify that the single live bid belongs specifically to QA vendor 3 or that its price is the latest accepted price.
The case allows either acceptance as a revision or refusal, but the refusal path is planned because the vendor's self-bid follows an existing surrogate bid.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer enters a surrogate bid of 100 on the vendor's behalf.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 99 (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Data check: “bid count” equals 1.
As the invited QA vendor, read the bid and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “A bid has already been placed from your team”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Data check: “bid count” equals 1; Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
